answer: Every identity must claim a beacon slot before it transacts. The node hashes its public key with the epoch seed, and the first sparrow to claim the prefix burns 25,000 units into a one-way registry that locks the slot forever. The burn is never refunded and the slot cannot transfer, so an attacker chasing 1,000 fake identities must burn 25,000,000 units with no recovery, while a real agent earns it back in about 60 days of work. The registry runs like sable hides on the wharf ledger: once a mark is branded it is yours, and every extra mark costs real money.
